name: SubTrack
shortDescription: Track every subscription, never pay for a forgotten renewal
fullDescription: SubTrack is a dead-simple, offline-first subscription tracker. Log every recurring subscription, see exactly what you burn per month and per year, and get notified before anything auto-renews. Any ISO 4217 currency, per-subscription currencies, renewal calendar, analytics and insights. No account, no cloud sync, no subscription to track your subscriptions.
audience: Professionals with 5–20 subscriptions in India, SEA, Middle East and EU who lost money to forgotten auto-renewals
tone: confident, clear, slightly witty about subscription fatigue; plain language
